scenes.headline:
BUILD A GAME
FROM A DOODLE
scenes.voiceText: Here is how I turned a frog doodle into a playable browser game with AI.

scenes.headline:
STEP 1: GIVE AI
THE DRAWING + RULES
scenes.voiceText: I gave AI the drawing and asked for a browser game: tap to jump, dodge rocks, collect stars for ten points, and restart after a hit.

scenes.headline:
STEP 2: RUN
THE GAME
scenes.voiceText: Then I opened the generated game in my browser.

scenes.headline:
STEP 3: TEST
THE JUMP
scenes.voiceText: I tested the controls. A tap makes the frog jump over a rock.

scenes.headline:
TEST THE SCORE:
000 → 010
scenes.voiceText: Collecting a star changes the score from zero to ten.

scenes.headline:
TEST GAME OVER
+ RESTART
scenes.voiceText: A collision ends the run, and Play Again starts a fresh one.

scenes.headline:
SKETCH. PROMPT.
TEST. IMPROVE.
scenes.voiceText: That is the workflow. I put the exact starter prompt in the caption so you can try it.
